data.name: Daiyaan
data.long_meaning: Someone who shows the right path to others, a guide, a helper, a supporter.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for someone who is always ready to help others in their spiritual journey, providing guidance and support.

in_arabic.name: ديان
in_arabic.long_meaning: ديان هو اسم عربي مشتق من نفس الجذر الذي يأتي منه كلمة دين، والمقصود به الحكم أو الدين، وقد أطلق على من يتحمل مسؤولية الحكم بين الناس، ومنه أيضا كلمة ديانة وتعني العدل، وقد ذكر اسم ديان في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحكم والعدل

in_urdu.name: دیان
in_urdu.long_meaning: دیان ایک عربی نام ہے جو دین کے 同 جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، اس سے مراد حکم یا عدل ہے، اور یہ ان لوگوں پر اطلاق ہوتا ہے جو لوگوں کے درمیان فیصلہ کرتے ہیں، اور یہاں سے ہی دیانت کا نام بھی لیا گیا ہے، جو عدل کو کہتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: दियान
in_hindi.long_meaning: दियान एक अरबी नाम है जो धर्म के समान जड़ से लिया गया है, इसका अर्थ न्याय या धर्म है, और यह उन लोगों पर लागू होता है जो लोगों के बीच निर्णय लेते हैं, और यहीं से धर्मनिकता का नाम भी लिया गया है, जो न्याय को कहते हैं

in_pashto.name: ديان
in_pashto.long_meaning: ديان د عربی نوم دی چې د دین څخه اخیستل شوی، دا نوم د حكم یا عدل معنی لري، او هغه کسانو ته کارول کیږي چې د خلکو تر منځ حكم کوي، او له همدې ځایه د دیانت نوم اخیستل شوی، چې عدل ته وایي

in_english.name: Daiyaan
in_english.long_meaning: Daiyaan is an Arabic name derived from the same root as the word deen, meaning judgment or religion, it refers to one who bears the responsibility of judging between people, and from this root also comes the word deen, meaning religion or way of life, it is a name that signifies fairness and justice

pronunciation.urdu: دیان تلفظ میں دال اور یاں پر زور دیا جاتا ہے
pronunciation.hindi: दियान उच्चारण में द और यान पर बल दिया जाता है
pronunciation.pashto: ديان د تلفظ دال او یان پر زور کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name "Daiyaan" holds a significant place in the Islamic culture as it is associated with the role of a guide or a leader who helps others navigate through life. It is a name that is highly respected as it signifies someone who is selfless, compassionate, and caring towards others. In the Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) has been described as a "Daiyaan" for humanity, leading the way towards the right path and the true meaning of life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Daiyaan" holds deep spiritual significance as it relates to the fundamental concept of guidance and support in the Islamic faith. It represents the idea that we are all interconnected and responsible for each other's spiritual and moral growth. By using this name, one acknowledges the importance of being a beacon of light and knowledge for others, and committing oneself to the path of righteousness and guidance, both for oneself and for those who look up to us. Additionally, it reflects the belief that no matter how lost or unsure one may feel, there is always a caring and compassionate guide and helper nearby.
